name: ONiO.zero
description: Wireless MCU integrating a radio and energy-harvesting power management.

pins.notes: User-named VMAIN bidirectional storage port is modeled; revision-specific package pin numbers remain unknown. See characterization.json for user-confirmed voltage thresholds and efficiency.

radio.notes: Official feature overview advertises Bluetooth LE 5.4 (1M, 2M, 125/500 kbit/s coded PHY), IEEE 802.15.4-2020 using 2.4 GHz O-QPSK, and programmable TX power from -40 to 0 dBm. The 250 kbit/s entry maps the declared 2.4 GHz O-QPSK PHY to its standard data rate. These are product-level capabilities, not revision-specific stack certification or characterized current/timing data. Do not substitute older ONiO.zero transmitter-only descriptions for this feature set. User-provided powers and timings are recorded separately in characterization.json and the runnable approximation; timing_status here describes manufacturer-source characterization.

simulation.scope: User-provided fixed-power CPU/sleep/BLE 1M/802.15.4 states and optional VMAIN storage. Direct solar, supply or battery harvesting input converts at 85%; surplus charges a connected capacitor, supercapacitor or compatible storage battery. Explicit activity timings remain required. Values and thresholds are not manufacturer-verified.
blockers: Obtain revision-specific datasheet, package pinout and measurement conditions.
Characterize voltage dependence, other PHYs/TX powers and combined CPU/radio states.
Characterize cold-start dynamics, off-state consumption, distinct shutdown threshold, voltage-dependent efficiency, output rails and storage battery charging chemistry.
